units.source_text: 《伊势物语》中诗歌：“嫩草美如玉，应有人来摘。

en.t: A poem in The Tales of Ise says: "The young grass is as beautiful as jade; surely someone will come to pluck it.

units.source_text: 我虽无此分，私心甚可惜。”

en.t: Though I have no such fate, in my heart I find it deeply regrettable."

units.source_text: 在五中将以嫩草比拟他的妹妹。

en.t: The Fifth-Rank Middle Captain uses the young grass as a comparison for his younger sister.
